data.long_meaning: Vianora is derived from the Latin name Viānā, which is composed of the elements 'viā' meaning 'life' and 'anā' meaning 'grace'. In Christian tradition, this name is a reminder of God's grace bestowed upon us, granting us the strength to live our lives in accordance with His will. The name Vianora carries the meaning “Strength and Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Vianora usually hope their child will grow to embody strength and grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
